errors.evidence: The first data point with a ROUGE-2 score of 21.49 does not have a data volume of exactly 0. Its position on the x-axis is slightly greater than 0.
The value 31.55 is a local peak, not the overall peak of the entire dataset. The absolute peak is 33.43 at a data volume of 40000, which makes this statement misleading.

The description fails to mention several explicitly labeled data points on the plot, which are crucial for understanding the line's trend. The missing points are: at data volume ~5000, ROUGE-2 is 26.63; at ~20000, ROUGE-2 is 31.31; and at ~30000, ROUGE-2 is 31.57.
